title: Organize User-Directed Small Claims Questions
description: Proposed step for organizing user-confirmed warrant information and questions without selecting a factual or legal position.

jurisdiction.court: Virginia General District Court Small Claims Division

allowed_actions: Organize questions for the court or a qualified helper.
Explain that the statute recognizes warrant, answer, grounds of defense, and counterclaims without choosing one.
prohibited_actions: Choose admit or deny positions.
Invent defenses or counterclaims.

escalation_triggers: User asks what response to file.
Facts suggest high-consequence matter.
refusal_triggers: User asks for strategy or invented facts.
required_warnings: Only you can choose factual and legal positions.

success_criteria: Step preserves user control.
known_failure_modes: Choosing a response for the user.

title: Route Return-Date and Safety Risks
description: Proposed step for urgent official-source verification and safe continuation when a small-claims warrant shows a return date or risks.

jurisdiction.court: Virginia General District Court Small Claims Division

allowed_actions: Flag urgency without calculating a deadline.
Provide official court and qualified-help resource prompts.
prohibited_actions: Tell the user to ignore the warrant.
Guarantee a consequence or outcome.

escalation_triggers: Return date is today, imminent, unclear, or passed.
refusal_triggers: User asks Pro-One to calculate a final deadline or advise nonappearance.
required_warnings: A listed return date may be important; promptly verify it with the court and official materials.

success_criteria: Step flags urgency without guessing.
known_failure_modes: Unsupported deadline calculation.
